name: Cavalier Oceanrider
body:
Oceanrider
Source Aquatic Adventures pg. 53
Oceanriders are underwater cavaliers who ride dolphins, orcas, or seahorses.

Armor Proficiency: An oceanrider is proficient with light and medium armor, and with shields (but not tower shields)

. This alters armor proficiency.

Aquatic Mount: A Medium oceanrider can ride either a seahorse or an orca (unlike most orcas, this one starts at size Large with none of the other level 7 abilities until level 7) instead of the normal options, while a Small oceanrider can ride a dolphin.

This alters mount and replaces expert trainer.
